g.text: directed graph: what depends on what
If a lyric changes, its speech usually changes too.
Arrows record which later results must be reconsidered.

g.text: stop / finish / discard policy
Whether running stage v can be stopped, or must
finish even when its result is no longer wanted.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: Revision IDs

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: content / timeline / settings versions
Content tracks lyric/flow changes; timeline tracks
beat timing; configuration tracks rendering settings.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: Session epoch

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: new session-generation identifier
Distinguishes a restarted session from an older one
so old asynchronous results cannot overwrite it.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #b34c42
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #b34c42

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: declared input/version requirement
The input version output j is judged against when
frozen. Later edits do not invalidate that played bar.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: Latest-version response delay
Time until a result for the requested
version is ready, not until it is heard.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: Obsolete work
Execution spent on a result no longer
needed. Not measured in this study.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: Fresh vs older
Fresh matches the required input cutoff.
An older version may be a permitted fallback.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
An edit costs work only through the results it changes and the work that can or cannot be stopped.
An average edit rate hides bursts, affected bars and whether edits arrive before or after freezing.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b34c42

g.text: EXAMPLE / TOPIC EDIT
Topic: space -> gardens
Apply from unfrozen bar 5 onward.
